summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend test of payment_admin.py (skip-payment toggle, coupons CRUD, /coupons/validate SP port, /coupons/redeem, /payments/skip-grant, org-types master). All 33 backend pytest cases PASS — every SP branch (ERR-0/1/2/3/4/5/6/9/10 + MSG-1/2/3 + 100% cap + value-floor-at-0) exercised end-to-end. Admin-only guards verified (non-admin user → 403 on /admin/* and on /payments/skip-grant when toggle OFF). Toggle ON correctly creates a payment_grants doc with amount_charged=0 and payment_method='ADMIN_SKIP'; coupon_code in body auto-redeems and bumps the user's usage_count. /api/payments/skip-grant/history scoped to current user. Org-Type seed contains all 6 system rows sorted by sort_order; system rows soft-disable on DELETE, custom rows hard-delete. Frontend /admin/payments page loads after admin login, all 3 sections render (Skip toggle, Coupons list with 'New' CTA, Org-Type master). No red screen, no JS errors. Deprecated packages detected: expo-av (warning logged on every page load — flagged in earlier iterations too).

ui_bugs.issue: TEST_PCT200_xxx coupon is displayed as '250%' in the chip — UI shows the raw stored discount_value (250) even though validation caps it at 100. Minor cosmetic; consider clamping the display to min(value,100) for Percentage type. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin/payments.tsx

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning logged: 'Expo AV has been deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54. Use the expo-audio and expo-video packages.' Not introduced by this iteration but persists across the app.
Console warning: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' — somewhere in the admin layout.
Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — RN Web migration pending; many screens trigger this.

action_items: OPTIONAL (low priority): Clamp Percentage display in /admin/payments coupon chips to min(value, 100) so admins don't see '250%'. Validation already caps correctly server-side.
MIGRATION (pre-SDK-54): Replace expo-av with expo-audio (audio) and expo-video (video) — flagged in iteration 15 too.
RN Web cleanup: replace shadow* style props with boxShadow and Image style.resizeMode with props.resizeMode.
critical_code_review_comments: payment_admin.py is 642 lines — borderline against the >700 line rule but still acceptable. If more coupon logic is added, split into routes/coupons.py + routes/payment_settings.py + routes/org_types.py.
delete_coupon does a SOFT delete (sets is_active='N') — correct, preserves usage history. Confirmed in test_err2_inactive (an inactive coupon returns ERR-2 in /validate).
applicable_org_types check raises ERR-8 when coupon restricts org_types but caller omits org_type — current spec lists ERR-9 only; this is a sensible extra guard and is documented in the code.
skip-grant safely re-checks the toggle server-side (line 585) — FE cannot bypass. Good security posture.
Coupon code is consistently uppercased on create + validate + redeem — verified.
Audit log row inserted on every payment_settings PUT (line 201-206) — verified via direct DB-side effects.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (page loads, 3 sections visible, toggle/new-coupon CTAs present)

seed_data_creation: Created 11 TEST_* coupons during this run (TEST_PCT_*, TEST_VAL_*, TEST_NET_*, TEST_EXP_*, TEST_FUT_*, TEST_INA_*, TEST_CAP_*, TEST_PUR_*, TEST_OFL_*, TEST_PCT200_* + ad-hoc registered user TEST_payadm_*@example.com). These are easily filterable by the 'TEST_' prefix. Skip-payment toggle was explicitly set back to OFF in teardown (test_zz_teardown_toggle_off).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_payment_admin.py is regression-ready. It depends on admin@test.com / AdminPass2026! existing and creates a throwaway user per run (TEST_payadm_<ts>_<rand>@example.com). The toggle is restored to OFF at the end; do NOT assume it is OFF mid-suite (TestSkipGrant toggles it ON). EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is used (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL — Expo's convention).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in the feature implementation.
